name: Ikenai Kankei
source:
Main character is a newly appointed science teacher. He happens to see female student Saeki being bullied, and helps her. From that day she trusts protagonist and seeks his attention. Whether he wants do develop pure love or insult relations, depends on him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名刚刚赴任的理科教师。他偶然看到女学生佐伯和奈遭人欺凌，便出手帮助了她。从那天起，和奈对他深信不疑，也不断寻求他的关注。究竟是与她发展一段纯爱，还是将两人的关系化为凌辱，全取决于主人公。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
